clare: heads-up: brought ember-embed-micro|int6 to staging. quick smoke shows recall@5 regressed on short queries and two topical clusters collapsed. posting initial numbers.
noah: which eval slice? short only? which dataset?

eval-bot: run summary for ember-embed-micro|int6|staging:
``
dataset: redwood-ssim-8k
metric: recall@5 overall: 0.701 (fp16 baseline: 0.767)
short-queries (<30 tok) recall@5: 0.545 (baseline 0.642)
long-queries (>=120 tok) recall@5: 0.784 (baseline 0.801)
mean silhouette: 0.19 (baseline 0.36)

clare: big short-query delta. UMAP: https://redwood-internal/umap/ember/int6/21.png
noah: suspects: quant per-tensor with aggressive clipping, normalization mismatch (pre vs post), or inadvertent dimension drop in build. Did you enable dim_prune?
clare: staging build used dim_prune=0.985 and post-quant normalization. eval harness normalizes pre-quant. will try swapping.
zhen: enqueue experiments: (A) pre-quant-norm, (B) per-channel quant, (C) disable dim_prune. also run a top-1 discordant check for 300 short queries.
eval-bot: queued experiments [pre-quant-norm, per-channel-quant, no-dim-prune], ETA 35m.
ops-bot: reserving 1 staging GPU at 18:10 UTC for 45m.
noah: if pre-quant norm recovers >4% recall@5 on short queries, change default pipeline. otherwise consider hybrid routing by query length.
clare: starting the jobs now, will post diffs and discordant list. thanks :rocket:
